rows.en:
\p, good timing.
I was just looking for you.

Here's my return gift for Valentine's.
Take it.

Thank you, Michel-kun.
...Wait, what is this?

Fashion glasses with no prescription.
I bet they'd look great on you.
Wow... Thank you so much, Michel-kun.

Glad you like them.
I picked out something I thought would suit you,
so try them on sometime, okay?
Sure, I'll wear them next time.

(He actually thought about a present for me...
I'm really happy.
Thank you, Michel-kun.)

\p-san, good timing!
There's something I wanted to give you.

This is a return gift for Valentine's.
Please accept it.

Thank you, Luca-kun.
...Wait, what is this?

It's a vacuum cleaner I built myself.
It's a special model: quiet, yet high-powered!
Wow... Thank you so much, Luca-kun.

I'm glad you like it!
It was worth building.

Oh, Nanase.
This is a return gift for Valentine's Day,
if you'd like it.

\p-kun!
Are you sure? Thank you so much!
I hope you like it...

This is... a paintbrush case!
And the pattern's so cute... Thank you!
Yeah, go ahead and use it!
Yes, I'll start using it right away!
Yeah. Let's keep getting along.
Yes, likewise!
(Looks like Nanase liked it!)
Ranka, here's your return gift for White Day.

Wow~ Thank you...!
Ehehe, this is kinda embarrassing...
Go ahead and open it, if you want.
Huh... This is...

Yeah. I want to keep listening to your songs
forever, Ranka, so I got you throat drops.
They're pretty rare, you know.

Of course.
I bought them for you, Ranka.
rows.notes: Answers Ranka's 'Can I really have this?' (c23263).

rows.en: Th-thank you... \p-kun.
(I'm glad Ranka seemed happy with it.)

Oh, Sheryl.
This is a return gift for Valentine's Day,
if you'd like it.

Oh, \p?
You didn't have to go to all that trouble...
Hm? Sheryl, what's wrong?
rows.notes: Sheryl has spotted the gift and is staring at it.

rows.en: Huh... What's that?

It's Galaxy Candy, from a shop
in Deep Akihabara... It's popular for
its colorful look and poppy design!
rows.notes: Reflowed within 3 lines. Fukashi Akihabara = Deep Akihabara (glossary).

rows.en:
Ooh, how cute~!!
...Is that for me?

Thank you~!!
You've got pretty good taste!
I'll be counting on you from now on, too!
Oh, uh, yeah. Same here.

(I can't believe Sheryl was that happy...
That made the present totally worth it!)

Klan-senpai,
it's White Day, so here's my return gift.

Y-yes, well...
This is strangely embarrassing, isn't it?
Th-this is...

You said your hobby was fashion, Senpai,
so I bought you some clothes I thought
would look good on you.
Am I truly allowed to have this?

Of course.
I bought them for you, Klan-senpai.

Oh, no need to thank me...
Please keep looking out for me,
Klan-senpai.
Mm, and I'm counting on you as well!

(Klan-senpai seemed happy, so I'm
really glad I gave her a return gift.)

(It's already been two weeks
since Sheryl transferred here...)

(I feel like the restless mood at Mihoshi
has finally settled down quite a bit.)

(When she first transferred,
Mihoshi was all Sheryl, all the time...)
Excuse me, do you have a moment?
rows.notes: ??? (woman) = Grace, unnamed until c23349; shared male/female.

rows.en: Y-yes?

I'm sorry, but would you mind
taking this to Sheryl for me?

That girl was so looking forward to
swimming class, and then she went
and forgot her swimsuit...
(She seems to know Sheryl, but...)
rows.notes: 'She' = the woman; the plate says woman.

rows.en: Um... and who exactly are you...?

Oh, I'm sorry, I haven't even
introduced myself yet.

I'm Grace O'Connor.
I'm Sheryl's manager.

Oh! So you're Sheryl's manager.
My name is......
rows.notes: Manager-san: job title, translated without honorific (brief: tenin-san -> 'the clerk').

rows.en:
\p-kun, from Mihoshi Academy High,
Pilot Course, Class 2-B, right?

Yes, that's right...
Wait, how do you know my name?

Hehe, sorry for startling you.
The truth is, I have implants in my body.

So I just took a peek into Mihoshi's network
and looked up your information.

(Implants... That's the tech that mechanizes
the human body to enhance it physically
or boost information processing, right?)
Wow, that sounds handy.
Then how about you? Want to get implants too?

Hehe, just kidding.
Implants are illegal on the Frontier, after all.

Well then, sorry for the trouble, but
I'm counting on you to get that to Sheryl.

(So that's Sheryl's manager, Grace-san.
She seemed like a really kind, nice person...)
rows.notes: Matches the female c23371 in slice 323.

rows.en:
(Oh, right, I'd better hurry and take Sheryl
the thing she forgot...)

(It's already been two weeks
since Sheryl-san transferred here...)

(I feel like the restless mood at Mihoshi
has finally settled down quite a bit.)

(When she first transferred,
Mihoshi was all Sheryl-san, all the time...)
(She seems to know Sheryl-san, but...)

Oh!
So you're Sheryl-san's manager.
My name is......

\p-san, from Mihoshi Academy High,
Pilot Course, Class 2-B, right?

Yes, that's right...
Wait, how do you know my name?

(Implants... That's the tech that mechanizes
the human body to enhance it physically
or boost information processing, right?)
